name: Golang Generic
author: grandpaacademy
description: A generic Go egg for building and running Go applications. Supports git clone, go mod tidy, and custom build/run commands.
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ {{AUTO_UPDATE}} == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; if [[ ! -f /home/container/{{MAIN_FILE}} ]]; then echo "Main file not found!"; exit 1; fi; if [ -f go.mod ]; then /usr/local/go/bin/go mod tidy; fi; if [ "${BUILD_ONLY}" == "1" ]; then /usr/local/go/bin/go build -o /home/container/server ${GO_BUILD_ARGS} .; else /usr/local/go/bin/go run ${GO_RUN_ARGS} /home/container/{{MAIN_FILE}}; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Golang App Installation Script
apt update
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo -e "assuming user knows what they are doing have a good day."
    exit 0
fi

if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
fi

if [ -z "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    echo -e "using anon api call"
else
    GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
    echo -e "/mnt/server directory is not empty."
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        echo -e ".git directory exists"
        if [ -f .git/config ]; then
            ORIGIN=$(git config --get remote.origin.url)
        else
            echo -e "files found with no git config"
            exit 10
        fi
    fi
    if [ "${ORIGIN}" == "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
        echo "pulling latest from github"
        git pull
    fi
else
    echo -e "/mnt/server is empty.\ncloning files into repo"
    if [ -z ${BRANCH} ]; then
        git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    else
        git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    fi
fi

if [ -f /mnt/server/go.mod ]; then
    echo "Installing go modules..."
    /usr/local/go/bin/go mod download
fi

echo -e "install complete"
exit 0

variables.name: Git Repo Address
variables.description: Git repo to clone. I.E. https://github.com/user/repo

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: What branch to pull from github. Default is blank to pull the repo default branch.

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description: Skip all the install stuff if you are letting a user upload files. 0 = false (default) 1 = true

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Pull the latest files on startup when using a GitHub repo.

variables.name: Main file
variables.description: The main Go file to run (e.g. main.go).

variables.name: Build Only Mode
variables.description: Build the binary and run it (1) or use 'go run' (0). Build mode is recommended for production.

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Password to use with git. It's best practice to use a Personal Access Token.
